Gameplay: Harry17P (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: What color would you pick to hide? 🚗
clips.motivo: Hidden rule: cops hunt a specific car, respray breaks it

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 a quick *respray* can fool the cops?
They're hunting for one *specific* car.
So pull into a *Pay 'n' Spray* garage.
Change the *paint* in seconds.
They're looking for *pink*, you leave in red or grey.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #17: RESPRAY Your Car To Fool Cops 🎨

clips.descripcion:
In GTA 6, commit a crime as a duo and police look for Jason and Lucia together. Split up to break it.

Gameplay: Harry17P (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Would you ever split up mid-escape? 🤔
clips.motivo: Hidden police rule: the duo itself is a clue, split up to lose it

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 cops hunt Jason and Lucia *together*?
Rob a place as a *duo* and that's the description.
Hold *right* on the d-pad to talk to your partner.
Pick *split up* from the menu.
Your partner leaves and you no longer *match*.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #18: Cops Hunt Jason & Lucia TOGETHER 👥

clips.descripcion:

Gameplay: Harry17P (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: Which clue would you ditch first? 👀
clips.motivo: Hidden police system: the six clues cops use to identify you

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 the cops track *six things* about you?
Rob a shop and the *heat* stays on you.
Your *face*, your clothes, your gun, your car,
whether you're *together*, and even *CCTV* footage.
Come back *unchanged* and they chase you again.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #19: Cops Track 6 THINGS About You 🚨

Gameplay: Harry17P (YouTube)
#GTA6 #ViceCity #GTAVI
clips.comentario: What outfit are you keeping in your trunk? 👀
clips.motivo: Hidden system: trunk wardrobe + weapon storage to drop heat clues

narracion.texto: Did you know that in GTA 6 your car *trunk* holds a spare outfit?
Swap clothes *on the spot*.
At a clothes shop, just hit *add to trunk*.
The trunk hides your *long guns* too.
Store them so cops can't *spot* the weapon.

clips.titulo: GTA 6 Secrets #20: Your Car TRUNK Hides You From Cops 👕
